Reasoning: This stage keeps the panda_fingertip pose fixed while establishing a real grasp on cube_1. The fixed world position is represented by freeze_position with the specified 0.01 m tolerance, and the fixed world orientation is represented by freeze_orientation with the specified 0.05 rad tolerance. No new tool +z or +y axis relation is added. The grasp requirement is represented with object_grasped rather than close_gripper, because the stage explicitly requires firm physical holding/contact feedback and says gripper joint closure alone is not sufficient; the API also forbids emitting close_gripper and object_grasped together. Stable opposing finger effort/contact and no-slip feedback are not separately expressible as condition labels, so they are captured semantically by object_grasped and noted here.
